extraction_notes.note: Each is one align with several split blocks numbered separately ((2.1)-(2.2), (2.5)-(2.7)); the facts report one equation per align, so each became a single equation node.

The proof of Theorem 2 is spread through Section 2 in prose, interleaved with Lemmas 1-5 and setup definitions; it was split into reduction/decomposition claims plus the labelled final paragraph PP6 instead of one proof node spanning the lemmas.

A_delta and nu_M are defined only inside Theorem 2's statement, yet Theorem 2's proof relies on Lemmas 1, 4, 5 that use them; those notation edges from TP2 are marked mention to avoid a results cycle.

DP4 is one sentence introducing both the overlap and xi; DP36 spans several sentences introducing L, G, z, y, eta that only serve Psi_M. Kept whole rather than splitting into non-self-contained fragments.
The upper bound half of Theorem 1 is only cited (Guerra/Talagrand); taken as external theorems feeding TP1 rather than as a proof part of TP1.
Historical introduction, acknowledgement, the remark on external fields after Theorem 1, and connective sentences (e.g. redefining H^pert with u=u^{M,N}) were not made nodes.
